A free lion is awarded for achieving [[Zoo and reputation levels#Zoo Titles (reputation)|Zoo Title]] 2 from the Mayor Quests. A second free lion is awarded for reaching level 42. Their puzzle pieces are available from any main zoo [[Chests and Keys|chest]] and the [[Prize Wheel|prize wheel]]. Lions can be purchased from the [[Rescue Center]], the [[Ice Cream Vendor]], and on rare occasion a [[Super Deals|Super Deal]]. They are needed for [[Club contests|Contests]] and [[Collections]] (White variant is also needed for Collections). They have been featured as [[Monthly rewards|login rewards]] in various calendars as early as 2018. == Description== Lions are some of the biggest members of the cat family. The Lion is a big wild cat with short, tawny-colored fur and white underparts. The long tail ends with a black tuft. These animals display sexual dimorphism with males, having their distinctive manes, ranging in color from black to blond. Still found in large parts of sub-Sahara Africa and a small patch of western India, Lions are the only big cat that lives in larger social groups. A Lions roar can be heard by humans up to 8 km (5 miles) away. Lions are generalist hypercarnivores. They primarily hunt on zebras, antelopes, gazelles, deer, buffalos, young giraffes, warthogs, wildebeest, young elephants, and less frequently - on hares and birds. ==Unlocking in Game-play== *Lions are featured in a Level 19 Quest ~ [[Quests#King|King of the Animals]].
